source.author: Francis X. Weiser, S.J.
source.rights: Still copyrighted. Inventory contains original factual labels, never copied extended book text.
caveats: 1958 historical author, not current discipline or current ritual law.
Foreword explicitly excludes independent folklore treatment of Holy Family, Christ the King, Sacred Heart, Holy Name.
Some Catholic-adopted practices are of Protestant origin (notably the German Advent wreath).
Some folklore includes rejected magical claims; EXCLUDE never auto-publishes.
No source book can establish actual practice in every diocese or parish.
